_note: Used only when the job runs on GitHub Actions and JOB_LIMIT etc. are not set. The full run (thousands of orders, ~100 GB of scans) belongs on the owner's PC, where the defaults are: no limit, no time budget, keep the scanned PDFs in the cache.
_recheck_note: recheck: true (or env JOB_RECHECK=1) runs the opt-in pdfplumber RECHECK pass instead of locating new orders: it rechecks found orders whose result is medium/low (needs_page_check true) and may upgrade them to high only with explicit positional evidence. See README 'Recheck pass'. recheck_github_limit caps the orders rechecked per GitHub run.
